/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import csv
import io
from decimal import Decimal
from api import order_summary
from csv_export import render_order

for amount, expected in [('12', '12.00'), ('12.345', '12.34'), ('-7.5', '-7.50'), ('0', '0.00')]:
    for order_id, currency in [('123', 'USD'), ('id,\"quoted\"\\nnext', 'currency,\"quoted\"\\r\\nnext')]:
        order = {'id': order_id, 'total': Decimal(amount), 'currency': currency}
        assert order_summary(order) == {'id': order_id, 'total': expected, 'currency': currency}
        rendered = render_order(order)
        assert rendered.startswith('id,total,currency\\r\\n')
        assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(rendered))) == [
            ['id', 'total', 'currency'], [order_id, expected, currency]
        ]
print('Passed 8 cases: API fields, decimal formatting, CSV header, one order row, and escaping.')
PY
 git diff --check
 git diff -- api.py csv_export.py"
